turns.q: Can it arrive gift-ready, and how fast can it ship?
turns.replyTail:
nd how fast can it ship?

It can get there quickly, but SPANX orders arrive in our standard packaging, not gift boxes or gift wrap, so adding your own ribbon or gift bag is the best way to make it gift-ready. ❤️

Shipping in the U.S.:

Standard: 5-9 business days
Basic: 3-4 business days
Expedited: 1-2 business days
Overnight: 1 business day

Orders placed after 12 PM EST start processing the next business day. If you want, I can help you pick the best option based on when you need it delivered.
